name: Fall Off the Bone Oven Baked Ribs
desc: Baby back ribs baked low under foil until tender, then broiled with a quick ketchup and Sriracha BBQ sauce.

source.title: Easy Fall Off the Bone Oven Baked Ribs
source.evidence: Identical ingredient list and amounts (2 to 2 1/2 lb baby backs; sauce of 1 tbsp oil, 1/4 cup onion, 1/2 tsp cumin, 1/2 cup ketchup, 1 tbsp Sriracha, 2 tbsp light brown sugar, 1 tbsp cider vinegar) and the same 275°F foil-covered bake.

ingredients.raw: 2 to 2 1/2 lb baby back pork ribs
Salt and black pepper, for seasoning generously
1 tbsp hot chili sauce (such as Sriracha)

steps: Preheat the oven to 275°F. Have ready a large roasting pan or rimmed baking sheet and aluminum foil.
Remove the thin membrane from the back of the rack: slide a knife under it at one end, then peel it off with your fingers (grip with a kitchen towel if it is slippery).
Season both sides of the ribs generously with salt and pepper.
Place the ribs meaty side down in the pan, cutting the rack in half if needed to fit. Cover tightly with foil, or wrap the racks individually in foil packets.
Bake 2 1/2 to 3 1/2 hours, checking at 2 hours, until the meat pulls easily from the bone and a knife slides in with no resistance.

While the ribs bake, make the sauce: Heat the oil in a small saucepan over medium heat and cook the onion until soft, 5-8 minutes. Add the cumin and cook 30 seconds. Stir in the ketchup, Sriracha, brown sugar, and vinegar, season with salt, and cook 2 minutes. Set aside.
Take the ribs out, discard the foil, and turn them meaty side up. Move an oven rack near the top and set the oven to broil on high.
Brush both sides of the ribs with the sauce and broil 3-4 minutes, watching closely, until the sauce bubbles and caramelizes.
